newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taipei Bank to issue T$1.5/shr dividend.
newsitem.headline: Taipei Bank to issue T$1.5/shr dividend.

text.p: Taipei Business Bank said its shareholders on Thursday approved a dividend of T$1.5 per share for 1996.
The dividend, to be paid on June 21, includes a cash dividend of T$0.6 per share, and a stock dividend, or bonus issue, of T$0.9 per share, the bank said in a statement.
The shareholders' meeting also approved a proposal for a rights issue of T$1.01 billion, which will increase its paid-in capital to T$12.06 billion, it said.
The rights issue will be completed later in 1997, it said.
The bank said it had applied to the finance ministry in late 1995 for conversion into a commercial bank, and hopes to become the first regional business bank to complete such conversion.
Currently, as a business bank, its operation is limited to certain area and 60 percent of its loans must be financed to businesses, thus limiting its operations, a bank official said.
"After conversion, both our image and profitability will increase," he said by telephone.
